# Luxembourg

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### ABBL - Luxembourg Bankers Association

**Role:** Luxembourg banking-community payment-standard coordinator and guideline publisher

**Reporting coverage:** National XML B2C account-statement guideline explicitly covers camt.053.001.02.

**Messages / versions:** camt.053.001.02; pain.001; pain.008; pain.002

- [National payment standards toolbox](https://www.abbl.lu/professionals/payments/) — availability; public-page
- [National XML statement guideline scope](https://www.abbl.lu/professionals/payments/xml-statement-message-guidelines/) — availability; public-page
- [Account-statement guideline 2.0, November 2021](https://www.abbl.lu/publications/abbl-payments-xml-message-statement/) — specification; linked-unverified

Official scope page identifies 053.001.02 and guide 2.0, November 2021. Publication offers a PDF on office-membernet.abbl.lu, but fetch failed; hostname alone does not prove membership restrictions. BIL bank guide separately confirms an adapted ABBL 053 guideline. No national 052/054 guide verified.
